melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.scope_ke.label: scope_keys
melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.scope_ke.role: Canonical scope-key construction: the closed namespace vocabulary plus the builders that are the ONLY sanctioned way to make a key.

melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.scope_ke.label: ScopePrefix
melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.scope_ke.role: The CLOSED vocabulary of scope-key namespaces - the levels this plane can isolate at, as a type rather than loose strings.
responsibilities: name each isolation level once, in one place
stay closed: a caller reaching for a non-member prefix is the signal a level is MISSING, not an invitation to format a string by hand

melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.scope_ke.label: ScopeKey
melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.scope_ke.role: The only sanctioned way to build a scope key, because a typo in a hand-written key does not fail loudly - it silently claims the wrong thing.
responsibilities: build FLAT, NAMESPACED keys - one string space with a subsystem or level prefix, keeping acquisition O(requested scopes) dict operations
express the HIERARCHY BY MODE, NOT BY KEY SHAPE: 'world' is the parent of every frame, but that relationship lives in the claim mode
never be instantiated - a namespace of static builders over ScopePrefix, holding no instance state
